source.title: Improve roadmap command failure diagnostics
source.objective: Retrospective friction from ChatGPT conversation 6ab8f2d7-ad14-83eb-b53b-c386288d3e46: command sequence roadmap_pull.py --repo . followed by sqlite3 failed with exit code 2 and no useful output, forcing a later retry using the SQLite query directly. Capture as avoidable retry/diagnostic friction; improve command construction/error surfacing so failures explain the exact cause and do not require redundant reruns.
source.next_action: Reassess after Symphony acquisition/migration scope is decided; resume only if the capability remains necessary outside Symphony.
